# Lab 10.8: Google Sheets & Drive External Tables

## What We Are Going to Do
Create an external table over a Google Sheet and query it live from BigQuery.

## Steps

1. **Create a sheet.** In Google Sheets create `BQ Targets` with this data in `Sheet1`:

   | country | target_orders |
   |---|---|
   | India | 5000 |
   | Japan | 3000 |
   | Brasil | 4000 |

   Copy the sheet URL.

2. **[CLI] Give Cloud Shell Drive access.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud auth login --enable-gdrive-access --update-adc</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Create the external table.** Replace `SHEET_URL`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE lab10.targets_sheet (country STRING, target_orders INT64)
OPTIONS (
  format = 'GOOGLE_SHEETS',
  uris = ['SHEET_URL'],
  skip_leading_rows = 1,
  sheet_range = 'Sheet1!A1:B100'
);

SELECT * FROM lab10.targets_sheet;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Join live sheet data with BigQuery data.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT t.country, t.target_orders, COUNT(o.order_id) AS actual_orders
FROM lab10.targets_sheet t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON u.country = t.country
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` o ON o.user_id = u.id
GROUP BY 1, 2;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Change the sheet and re-run.** Change India's target to `6000` in Sheets, then run step 4 again. The new value appears immediately.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Source | Google Sheet, read live |
| Permissions | Drive access for the person querying |
| Use case | Small business-maintained lookups |
| Limit | Slow for large sheets |
